description: The debt-to-income ratio is total monthly debt payments divided by gross monthly income, shown as a percent, and this tool computes it for a borrower (plus the housing-only ratio, if given). Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

monthly_debts.description: All monthly debt payments incl. housing, USD.

title: Debt-to-income (DTI) ratio calculator
